# Learner

## Summary
A person who takes cohorts; extends PersonBase, adds organisation, timezone, optional linked Employee.

## Usage
`linksTo(() => Learner)` from Enrollment.

## Non-goals
Not an auth identity.

## Example
The linked example is a learner with an organisation and timezone. A learner can exist without an employee record, for external students.
